title: Questions raised over halted Wolbachia dengue project
summary: Questions have been raised over the fate of Sri Lanka’s pilot project involving the use of Wolbachia bacteria to control dengue, with specialist Dr. Chamal Sanjeewa claiming that the initiative was discontinued despite its potential benefits.

title: Dengue passes 1,000 cases daily
summary: Sri Lanka is experiencing an unprecedented surge in dengue infections, with more than 1,000 cases reported within a single day.

title: E. coli, coliform tests on 50 water sources under ’Thirasara Diyawara’ programme
summary: Water quality tests were conducted on 100 water sources supplying 163 community water projects, while water samples from 50 selected locations were subjected to microbiological analysis to detect bacterial contamination, including Total Coliform and Escherichia coli (E. coli), under the government’s newly launched ’’Thirasara Diyawara’’ (Sustainable Waters) National Programme.

title: Pentagon seeks $80 billion from congress for Iran War amid peace talks
summary: The Pentagon has told senators it needs roughly $80 billion, mostly to cover the cost of the US war against Iran, adding to what is already a sizable military spending boost being sought by President Donald Trump.

title: 24-hour water cut in several Colombo suburbs from June 24
summary: The National Water Supply and Drainage Board (NWSDB) has announced a 24-hour interruption to water supply in several areas due to essential maintenance work on the main water transmission line from Labugama and Kalatuwawa to Maharagama.

title: Sri Lanka risks losing GSP+ over slow progress into PTA reforms: Joint opposition question
summary: Sri Lanka risks losing the GSP+ trade benefit, a special benefit enjoyed by Sri Lankan exporters for accessing markets in the European Union, because of the slow progress of reforms related to the Prevention of Terrorism Act (PTA), Joint Opposition Convener Prof. G. L. Peiris said yesterday.

title: Infant allegedly tied to chair and beaten for crying- suspect remanded
summary: A man accused of tying a nine-month-old infant to a chair and assaulting her with an umbrella handle and his hands for allegedly crying frequently was ordered to be remanded till July 3 by Colombo Additional Magistrate Lahiru Silva yesterday.

title: Southwest Monsoon active but weakened by El Niño conditions
summary: Sri Lanka is currently experiencing an active Southwest Monsoon with less vigour due to El Niño conditions, a senior official from the Department of Meteorology said yesterday.

title: At least 18 dead in France, including two children in hot car, as Europe bakes
summary: At least 18 people died in France, including two children left in a hot car, as a heatwave hung over Europe, smashing temperature records in several cities on Monday.

title: Police Inspector arrested inside hotel for accepting Rs. 1 Mn bribe
summary: A Police Inspector was arrested by officials from the Commission to Investigate Allegations of Bribery or Corruption (CIABOC) while accepting a bribe of Rs. 1 million at a hotel in Kalutara North.

title: PMD, SLC denies ICC Chief discussed SLC elections or blacklisting
summary: The President’s Media Division (PMD) yesterday denied the Daily Mirror article titled “Hold SLC Elections or Get Blacklisted, ICC Informs President AKD,” saying that ICC Chairman Jay Shah neither discussed the holding of Sri Lanka Cricket (SLC) elections nor raised the possibility of blacklisting the national cricket body over political interference.

title: MESSI MAKES HISTORY: Argentina Legend Breaks World Cup Goalscoring Record
summary: Lionel Messi has become the FIFA World Cup’s all-time leading goalscorer after scoring twice in Argentina’s 2-0 victory over Austria.

title: Messi sets World Cup scoring record as Argentina advances to knockout stage
summary: Lionel Messi scored twice, including a record-breaking 17th World Cup goal, to become the all-time leading goal-scorer in tournament history.

title: FIFA World Cup 2026 Round of 32 Bracket and Schedule: Road to the Final Takes Shape
summary: For the first time in the tournament’s history, 48 nations are chasing 32 knockout spots. Here is the complete bracket, schedule, and survival guide for Sri Lankan fans tracking the run to the Finals.

title: Which teams have qualified for the FIFA World Cup 2026 knockouts, round of 32?
summary: Here’s everything you need to know about the FIFA World Cup 2026 knockout stage, including the Round of 32 qualification rules, tiebreaker criteria, qualified teams and nations eliminated from the tournament.
